# Beck Institute Cares

> Beck Institute Cares provides evidence-based CBT therapy and cognitive behavioral wellness coaching for mental health treatment and personal wellness.

Beck Institute Cares offers comprehensive mental health services including cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) for anxiety, depression, and psychological disorders, along with wellness coaching for stress management and behavioral change. The platform features a client portal for appointment scheduling and health record access, a certified clinician directory, and educational resources for patients and healthcare providers.

## Core Services & Treatment

- [Home](https://cares.beckinstitute.org): Beck Institute Cares homepage featuring CBT therapy and wellness coaching services
- [About Us](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/about-us): About Beck Institute Cares: CBT therapy and wellness coaching services overview
- [Therapy Services](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/therapy-services): CBT therapy services for anxiety, depression, and psychological disorders
- [Cognitive Behavioral Wellness Coaching](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/wellness-coaching): Cognitive Behavioral Wellness Coaching for stress, sleep, and behavioral change
- [Therapy or Coaching: Which is Right for Me?](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/blog/therapy-or-coaching-which-is-right-for-me): Blog post comparing CBT therapy and wellness coaching to help choose the right fit

## Patient Access & Scheduling

- [Schedule an Appointment](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/schedule-appointment): Schedule appointments with Beck Institute Cares clinical services team
- [Client Portal](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/get-treatment/client-portal): Client portal for appointment scheduling, secure messaging, and health records access
- [Beck Institute CBT Certified Clinician Directory](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/clinician-directory): Find Beck Institute CBT Certified Clinicians for evidence-based therapy services
- [Clinician Directory (Alternative Link)](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/get-treatment/clinician-directory): Directory to find Beck Institute CBT Certified Clinicians for mental health treatment

## Resources & Education

- [CBT Resources](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/cbt-resources): CBT resources including FAQs, self-help guides, and mental health education
- [Thinking Well Newsletter](https://cares.beckinstitute.org/contact-us/thinking-well-newsletter): Subscribe to Thinking Well Newsletter for mental health news, wellness tips, and CBT resources
